questions.text: Name the Indian epics.
questions.text_as_printed: Name the Indian epics. (Easy)

answer.value:
There are two very important and sacred epics in Indian literature and culture. They are:
Ramayana: It was composed by Adi Kavi Maharshi Valmiki. It describes the life, ideals, and virtues of Lord Rama.
Mahabharata: It was composed by Maharshi Vedavyasa. It is the story of the Dharma Yuddha (righteous war) between the Kauravas and the Pandavas, and is one of the largest epics in the world. The Bhagavad Gita is a part of the Mahabharata.

questions.text: Explain the differences between the society of the Early Vedic Period and that of the Later Vedic Period.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the differences between the society of the Early Vedic Period and that of the Later Vedic Period. (Difficult)

answer.value:
Early Vedic period (Rigvedic period): Women had good status, participated in Sabha, Samiti, and Vidhat, no child marriage or Sati practice, king consulted elders, worship of deities.
Later Vedic period (Yajurveda, Samaveda, Atharvaveda): Women's status declined, Vidhat disappeared, Sati and child marriage practices started, king became powerful, religious rituals became complex and difficult.
